texts:
The Week 7 wire: a Saints backfield, two new full-time receivers and a Rams offense without Davante Adams.

Kendre Miller, claim 10 to 20 percent.
Omar Cooper Jr., claim 6 to 12 percent.
Germie Bernard, claim 5 to 10 percent.
#Saints #JetUp #HereWeGo #RamsHouse

1. Kendre Miller, NO RB: a season-high 20 carries for 70 and 32 snaps @NYG, the most of any Saints back.

Travis Etienne Jr. is on IR through Week 8. Claim him, 10 to 20 percent.
#Saints #NYGiants

Alvin Kamara, NO RB: left in the second quarter with his back, scored on a 31-yard catch, then sat the whole fourth.

RB45 rest of season for me. Monitor Wednesday's practice report before PIT in Paris.
#Saints #HereWeGo

2. Omar Cooper Jr., NYJ WR: 82 percent of the snaps @NE in his first game off IR, 6 of 7 targets for 103 and a TD.

Adonai Mitchell is week to week. Claim him, 6 to 12 percent, before MIA.
#JetUp #NEPats #PhinsUp

3. Germie Bernard, PIT WR: 12 targets @TB, 11 for 87 and the overtime TD, a week after a team-high 9.

Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. are on IR. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent.
#HereWeGo #GoBucs

4. Mike Washington Jr., LV RB: a season-high 35 percent of the snaps vs BUF and half the early downs, 9 carries for 43.

RB46 rest of season for me. Claim him, 5 to 10 percent.
#RaiderNation #BillsMafia

Ashton Jeanty, LV RB: still 58 percent of the snaps, and he out-touched Washington 14 to 10.

RB8 rest of season for me. Hold him; Washington passing him in snaps is what would change it.
#RaiderNation

5. Keenan Allen, IND WR: 11 targets vs TEN, 8 for 82, after 9 in each of Weeks 4 and 5.

Tyler Warren is out with the groin. Claim him, 4 to 8 percent, for @MIN.
#ForTheShoe #TitanUp #Skol

6. Baker Mayfield, TB QB: threw Monday and is set to practice Wednesday on the right thumb. The MRI showed no further damage.

He is on 24 percent of rosters. Claim him, 3 to 6 percent.
#GoBucs

Emeka Egbuka, TB WR: 16 targets for 48 yards from Jalon Daniels in Week 6.

WR22 rest of season for me. Hold him through @CAR; Mayfield's return fixes the efficiency.
#GoBucs #KeepPounding

7. Tyler Higbee, LAR TE: 83 percent of the snaps vs ARI, and over 60 yards in each of the three games before that.

Davante Adams is out 6 to 10 weeks with the hamstring. Claim him, 2 to 4 percent.
#RamsHouse #BirdGang

8. Jaylin Noel, HOU WR: 12 of 12 targets for 233 yards over Weeks 4 to 6, including 4 for 107 and a TD @JAX.

Add him, 1 to 3 percent, for NYG.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL #NYGiants

Woody Marks, HOU RB: 15 carries for 56 @JAX with David Montgomery out.

Montgomery is week to week before the Week 8 bye. RB40 rest of season for me. Hold Marks.
#HTownMade #DUUUVAL

9. DeMario Douglas, NE WR: 7 of 8 targets for 86 and a TD vs NYJ, after 2 TDs in Week 5.

Romeo Doubs is on IR. Add him before Thursday @CHI, 1 to 3 percent.
#NEPats #JetUp #DaBears

Roschon Johnson, CHI RB: 13 carries for 51 and a TD @ATL to D'Andre Swift's 16, and he closed the game.

Kyle Monangai is expected to miss a third game. Add Johnson for Thursday, 0 to 2 percent.
#DaBears #DirtyBirds

10. Bam Knight, ARI RB: 15 carries for 80 @LAR on 32 snaps with Jeremiyah Love out, and most of the red-zone touches.

Add him, 1 to 3 percent, for DEN.
#BirdGang #RamsHouse #BroncosCountry

11. Tyrone Tracy Jr., NYG RB: 2 TDs on 8 touches vs NO on 38 percent of the snaps. Add him, 0 to 2 percent.

Cam Skattebo, NYG RB: 6 snaps, no touches. Hold him until Wednesday's report @HOU.
#NYGiants #Saints #HTownMade

Tight end stream.

Michael Mayer, LV TE: 7 of 9 targets for 95 vs BUF, after 8 for 82 in Week 4.

Stream him vs LAR, 0 to 2 percent, if your tight end is on bye.
#RaiderNation #BillsMafia #RamsHouse

Stashes.

Jonah Coleman, DEN RB: eligible to come off IR this week, with 58 yards and a TD in his last game.

Stash him, 2 to 4 percent. Monitor his first practice.
#BroncosCountry

Antonio Williams, WAS WR: led Washington's receivers in snaps and routes in Week 6, and Terry McLaurin was carted off Monday.

Stash him through the bye, 1 to 3 percent.
#RaiseHail

Terrance Ferguson, LAR TE: on IR until Week 8, and he scored in all four full games with a top Rams receiver out. Stash him, 1 to 3 percent.

Konata Mumpfield, LAR WR: 27 snaps as the third receiver. Stash him, 0 to 2 percent.
#RamsHouse

Cut bait.

Jalen Hurts, PHI QB: clots in both lungs, expected out for the season. Drop him.

Romeo Doubs, NE WR: on IR for at least four games. Drop him unless you have an IR spot.
#FlyEaglesFly #NEPats

MarShawn Lloyd, GB RB: 8 carries for 10, and Josh Jacobs is back. Drop him.

Tyjae Spears, TEN RB: 1 carry in Week 6. Drop him.

Tyler Allgeier, ARI RB: 18 carries for 38. Drop him.
#GoPackGo #TitanUp #BirdGang

Monday night: SF won 23-17.

Terry McLaurin, WAS WR: carted off with the left knee, feared season-ending. Monitor Tuesday's MRI.

Mike Evans, SF WR: left with the Achilles, came back, 94 yards. Monitor Wednesday's report.
#FTTB #RaiseHail

Every add, stash and drop, with the FAAB ranges and rostered numbers, is on the site.

Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the Week 7 Menu on Wednesday, and repost this for your league.

https://fantasykitchenff.com/market.html?week=7
